paragraphs.text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these words, he said unto his disciples,
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους, εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: Kai egeneto hote etelesen ho Iēsous pantas tous logous toutous, eipen tois mathētais autou·

paragraphs.text: Ye know that after two days the passover cometh, and the Son of man is delivered up to be crucified.
paragraphs.original: Οἴδατε ὅτι μετὰ δύο ἡμέρας τὸ πάσχα γίνεται, καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς τὸ σταυρωθῆναι.
paragraphs.translit: Oidate hoti meta dyo hēmeras to pascha ginetai, kai ho hyios tou anthrōpou paradidotai eis to staurōthēnai.

paragraphs.text: Then were gathered together the chief priests, and the elders of the people, unto the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas;
paragraphs.original: Τότε συνήχθησαν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ λαοῦ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τοῦ λεγομένου Καϊάφα,
paragraphs.translit: Tote synēchthēsan hoi archiereis kai hoi presbyteroi tou laou eis tēn aulēn tou archiereōs tou legomenou Kaiapha,

paragraphs.text: and they took counsel together that they might take Jesus by subtlety, and kill him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ συνεβουλεύσαντο ἵνα τὸν Ἰησοῦν δόλῳ κρατήσωσιν καὶ ἀποκτείνωσιν·
paragraphs.translit: kai synebouleusanto hina ton Iēsoun dolō kratēsōsin kai apokteinōsin·

paragraphs.text: But they said, Not during the feast, lest a tumult arise among people.
paragraphs.original: ἔλεγον δέ· Μὴ ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ, ἵνα μὴ θόρυβος γένηται ἐν τῷ λαῷ.
paragraphs.translit: elegon de· Mē en tē heortē, hina mē thorybos genētai en tō laō.

paragraphs.text: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
paragraphs.original: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ γενομένου ἐν Βηθανίᾳ ἐν οἰκίᾳ Σίμωνος τοῦ λεπροῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Tou de Iēsou genomenou en Bēthania en oikia Simōnos tou leprou,

paragraphs.text: there came unto him a woman having an alabaster cruse of exceeding precious ointment, and she poured it upon his head, as he sat at meat.
paragraphs.original: προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ γυνὴ ἔχουσα ἀλάβαστρον μύρου βαρυτίμου καὶ κατέχεεν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ ἀνακειμένου.
paragraphs.translit: prosēlthen autō gynē echousa alabastron myrou barytimou kai katecheen epi tēs kephalēs autou anakeimenou.

paragraphs.text: But when the disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
paragraphs.original: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἠγανάκτησαν λέγοντες· Εἰς τί ἡ ἀπώλεια αὕτη;
paragraphs.translit: idontes de hoi mathētai ēganaktēsan legontes· Eis ti hē apōleia hautē;

paragraphs.text: For this [ointment] might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
paragraphs.original: ἐδύνατο γὰρ τοῦτο πραθῆναι πολλοῦ καὶ δοθῆναι πτωχοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: edynato gar touto prathēnai pollou kai dothēnai ptōchois.

paragraphs.text: But Jesus perceiving it said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
paragraphs.original: γνοὺς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Τί κόπους παρέχετε τῇ γυναικί; ἔργον γὰρ καλὸν ἠργάσατο εἰς ἐμέ·
paragraphs.translit: gnous de ho Iēsous eipen autois· Ti kopous parechete tē gynaiki; ergon gar kalon ērgasato eis eme·

paragraphs.text: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
paragraphs.original: πάντοτε γὰρ τοὺς πτωχοὺς ἔχετε μεθʼ ἑαυτῶν, ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε·
paragraphs.translit: pantote gar tous ptōchous echete methʼ heautōn, eme de ou pantote echete·

paragraphs.text: For in that she poured this ointment upon my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
paragraphs.original: βαλοῦσα γὰρ αὕτη τὸ μύρον τοῦτο ἐπὶ τοῦ σώματός μου πρὸς τὸ ἐνταφιάσαι με ἐποίησεν.
paragraphs.translit: balousa gar hautē to myron touto epi tou sōmatos mou pros to entaphiasai me epoiēsen.

paragraphs.text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, that also which this woman hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
paragraphs.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὅπου ἐὰν κηρυχθῇ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦτο ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ κόσμῳ, λαληθήσεται καὶ ὃ ἐποίησεν αὕτη εἰς μνημόσυνον αὐτῆς.
paragraphs.translit: amēn legō hymin, hopou ean kērychthē to euangelion touto en holō tō kosmō, lalēthēsetai kai ho epoiēsen hautē eis mnēmosynon autēs.

paragraphs.text: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
paragraphs.original: Τότε πορευθεὶς εἷς τῶν δώδεκα, ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας Ἰσκαριώτης, πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς
paragraphs.translit: Tote poreutheis heis tōn dōdeka, ho legomenos Ioudas Iskariōtēs, pros tous archiereis

paragraphs.text: and said, What are ye willing to give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they weighed unto him thirty pieces of silver.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν· Τί θέλετέ μοι δοῦναι κἀγὼ ὑμῖν παραδώσω αὐτόν; οἱ δὲ ἔστησαν αὐτῷ τριάκοντα ἀργύρια.
paragraphs.translit: eipen· Ti thelete moi dounai kagō hymin paradōsō auton; hoi de estēsan autō triakonta argyria.

paragraphs.text: And from that time he sought opportunity to deliver him [unto them.]
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀπὸ τότε ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν ἵνα αὐτὸν παραδῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai apo tote ezētei eukairian hina auton paradō.

paragraphs.text: Now on the first [day] of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where wilt thou that we make ready for thee to eat the passover?
paragraphs.original: Τῇ δὲ πρώτῃ τῶν ἀζύμων προσῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες· Ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμέν σοι φαγεῖν τὸ πάσχα;
paragraphs.translit: Tē de prōtē tōn azymōn prosēlthon hoi mathētai tō Iēsou legontes· Pou theleis hetoimasōmen soi phagein to pascha;

paragraphs.text: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Teacher saith, My time is at hand; I keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν· Ὑπάγετε εἰς τὴν πόλιν πρὸς τὸν δεῖνα καὶ εἴπατε αὐτῷ· Ὁ διδάσκαλος λέγει· Ὁ καιρός μου ἐγγύς ἐστιν· πρὸς σὲ ποιῶ τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen· Hypagete eis tēn polin pros ton deina kai eipate autō· Ho didaskalos legei· Ho kairos mou engys estin· pros se poiō to pascha meta tōn mathētōn mou.

paragraphs.text: And the disciples did as Jesus appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐποίησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ ὡς συνέταξεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα.
paragraphs.translit: kai epoiēsan hoi mathētai hōs synetaxen autois ho Iēsous, kai hētoimasan to pascha.

paragraphs.text: Now when even was come, he was sitting at meat with the twelve disciples;
paragraphs.original: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης ἀνέκειτο μετὰ τῶν δώδεκα μαθητῶν
paragraphs.translit: Opsias de genomenēs anekeito meta tōn dōdeka mathētōn

paragraphs.text: and as they were eating, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐσθιόντων αὐτῶν εἶπεν· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι εἷς ἐξ ὑμῶν παραδώσει με.
paragraphs.translit: kai esthiontōn autōn eipen· Amēn legō hymin hoti heis ex hymōn paradōsei me.

paragraphs.text: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began to say unto him every one, Is it I, Lord?
paragraphs.original: καὶ λυπούμενοι σφόδρα ἤρξαντο λέγειν αὐτῷ εἷς ἕκαστος· Μήτι ἐγώ εἰμι, κύριε;
paragraphs.translit: kai lypoumenoi sphodra ērxanto legein autō heis hekastos· Mēti egō eimi, kyrie;

paragraphs.text: And he answered and said, He that dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· Ὁ ἐμβάψας μετʼ ἐμοῦ τὴν χεῖρα ἐν τῷ τρυβλίῳ οὗτός με παραδώσει·
paragraphs.translit: ho de apokritheis eipen· Ho embapsas metʼ emou tēn cheira en tō trybliō houtos me paradōsei·

paragraphs.text: The Son of man goeth, even as it is written of him: but woe unto that man through whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had not been born.
paragraphs.original: ὁ μὲν υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὑπάγει καθὼς γέγραπται περὶ αὐτοῦ, οὐαὶ δὲ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ διʼ οὗ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται· καλὸν ἦν αὐτῷ εἰ οὐκ ἐγεννήθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος.
paragraphs.translit: ho men hyios tou anthrōpou hypagei kathōs gegraptai peri autou, ouai de tō anthrōpō ekeinō diʼ hou ho hyios tou anthrōpou paradidotai· kalon ēn autō ei ouk egennēthē ho anthrōpos ekeinos.

paragraphs.text: And Judas, who betrayed him, answered and said, Is it I, Rabbi? He saith unto him, Thou hast said.
paragraphs.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν εἶπεν· Μήτι ἐγώ εἰμι, ῥαββί; λέγει αὐτῷ· Σὺ εἶπας.
paragraphs.translit: apokritheis de Ioudas ho paradidous auton eipen· Mēti egō eimi, rhabbi; legei autō· Sy eipas.

paragraphs.text: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it; and he gave to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
paragraphs.original: Ἐσθιόντων δὲ αὐτῶν λαβὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἄρτον καὶ εὐλογήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ δοὺς τοῖς μαθηταῖς εἶπεν· Λάβετε φάγετε, τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου.
paragraphs.translit: Esthiontōn de autōn labōn ho Iēsous arton kai eulogēsas eklasen kai dous tois mathētais eipen· Labete phagete, touto estin to sōma mou.

paragraphs.text: And he took a cup, and gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
paragraphs.original: καὶ λαβὼν ποτήριον καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων· Πίετε ἐξ αὐτοῦ πάντες,
paragraphs.translit: kai labōn potērion kai eucharistēsas edōken autois legōn· Piete ex autou pantes,

paragraphs.text: for this is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many unto remission of sins.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν τὸ αἷμά μου τῆς διαθήκης τὸ περὶ πολλῶν ἐκχυννόμενον εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν·
paragraphs.translit: touto gar estin to haima mou tēs diathēkēs to peri pollōn ekchynnomenon eis aphesin hamartiōn·

paragraphs.text: But I say unto you, I shall not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father`s kingdom.
paragraphs.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν, οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπʼ ἄρτι ἐκ τούτου τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ὅταν αὐτὸ πίνω μεθʼ ὑμῶν καινὸν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ πατρός μου.
paragraphs.translit: legō de hymin, ou mē piō apʼ arti ek toutou tou genēmatos tēs ampelou heōs tēs hēmeras ekeinēs hotan auto pinō methʼ hymōn kainon en tē basileia tou patros mou.

paragraphs.text: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out unto the mount of Olives.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὑμνήσαντες ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸ Ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai hymnēsantes exēlthon eis to Oros tōn Elaiōn.

paragraphs.text: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended in me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
paragraphs.original: Τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Πάντες ὑμεῖς σκανδαλισθήσεσθε ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ταύτῃ, γέγραπται γάρ· Πατάξω τὸν ποιμένα, καὶ διασκορπισθήσονται τὰ πρόβατα τῆς ποίμνης·
paragraphs.translit: Tote legei autois ho Iēsous· Pantes hymeis skandalisthēsesthe en emoi en tē nykti tautē, gegraptai gar· Pataxō ton poimena, kai diaskorpisthēsontai ta probata tēs poimnēs·

paragraphs.text: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.
paragraphs.original: μετὰ δὲ τὸ ἐγερθῆναί με προάξω ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.
paragraphs.translit: meta de to egerthēnai me proaxō hymas eis tēn Galilaian.

paragraphs.text: But Peter answered and said unto him, If all shall be offended in thee, I will never be offended.
paragraphs.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Εἰ πάντες σκανδαλισθήσονται ἐν σοί, ἐγὼ οὐδέποτε σκανδαλισθήσομαι.
paragraphs.translit: apokritheis de ho Petros eipen autō· Ei pantes skandalisthēsontai en soi, egō oudepote skandalisthēsomai.

paragraphs.text: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, that this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
paragraphs.original: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρὶς ἀπαρνήσῃ με.
paragraphs.translit: ephē autō ho Iēsous· Amēn legō soi hoti en tautē tē nykti prin alektora phōnēsai tris aparnēsē me.

paragraphs.text: Peter saith unto him, Even if I must die with thee, [yet] will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πέτρος· Κἂν δέῃ με σὺν σοὶ ἀποθανεῖν, οὐ μή σε ἀπαρνήσομαι. ὁμοίως καὶ πάντες οἱ μαθηταὶ εἶπαν.
paragraphs.translit: legei autō ho Petros· Kan deē me syn soi apothanein, ou mē se aparnēsomai. homoiōs kai pantes hoi mathētai eipan.

paragraphs.text: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto his disciples, Sit ye here, while I go yonder and pray.
paragraphs.original: Τότε ἔρχεται μετʼ αὐτῶν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς χωρίον λεγόμενον Γεθσημανί, καὶ λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς· Καθίσατε αὐτοῦ ἕως οὗ ἀπελθὼν ἐκεῖ προσεύξωμαι.
paragraphs.translit: Tote erchetai metʼ autōn ho Iēsous eis chōrion legomenon Gethsēmani, kai legei tois mathētais· Kathisate autou heōs hou apelthōn ekei proseuxōmai.

paragraphs.text: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and sore troubled.
paragraphs.original: καὶ παραλαβὼν τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς Ζεβεδαίου ἤρξατο λυπεῖσθαι καὶ ἀδημονεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: kai paralabōn ton Petron kai tous dyo hyious Zebedaiou ērxato lypeisthai kai adēmonein.

paragraphs.text: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: abide ye here, and watch with me.
paragraphs.original: τότε λέγει αὐτοῖς· Περίλυπός ἐστιν ἡ ψυχή μου ἕως θανάτου· μείνατε ὧδε καὶ γρηγορεῖτε μετʼ ἐμοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: tote legei autois· Perilypos estin hē psychē mou heōs thanatou· meinate hōde kai grēgoreite metʼ emou.

paragraphs.text: And he went forward a little, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, My Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass away from me: nevertheless, not as I will, but as thou wilt.
paragraphs.original: καὶ προελθὼν μικρὸν ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ προσευχόμενος καὶ λέγων· Πάτερ μου, εἰ δυνατόν ἐστιν, παρελθάτω ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦτο· πλὴν οὐχ ὡς ἐγὼ θέλω ἀλλʼ ὡς σύ.
paragraphs.translit: kai proelthōn mikron epesen epi prosōpon autou proseuchomenos kai legōn· Pater mou, ei dynaton estin, parelthatō apʼ emou to potērion touto· plēn ouch hōs egō thelō allʼ hōs sy.

paragraphs.text: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ εὑρίσκει αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, καὶ λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ· Οὕτως οὐκ ἰσχύσατε μίαν ὥραν γρηγορῆσαι μετʼ ἐμοῦ;
paragraphs.translit: kai erchetai pros tous mathētas kai heuriskei autous katheudontas, kai legei tō Petrō· Houtōs ouk ischysate mian hōran grēgorēsai metʼ emou;

paragraphs.text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
paragraphs.original: γρηγορεῖτε καὶ προσεύχεσθε, ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν· τὸ μὲν πνεῦμα πρόθυμον ἡ δὲ σὰρξ ἀσθενής.
paragraphs.translit: grēgoreite kai proseuchesthe, hina mē eiselthēte eis peirasmon· to men pneuma prothymon hē de sarx asthenēs.

paragraphs.text: Again a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, My Father, if this cannot pass away, except I drink it, thy will be done.
paragraphs.original: πάλιν ἐκ δευτέρου ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο λέγων· Πάτερ μου, εἰ οὐ δύναται τοῦτο παρελθεῖν ἐὰν μὴ αὐτὸ πίω, γενηθήτω τὸ θέλημά σου.
paragraphs.translit: palin ek deuterou apelthōn prosēuxato legōn· Pater mou, ei ou dynatai touto parelthein ean mē auto piō, genēthētō to thelēma sou.

paragraphs.text: And he came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐλθὼν πάλιν εὗρεν αὐτοὺς καθεύδοντας, ἦσαν γὰρ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ βεβαρημένοι.
paragraphs.translit: kai elthōn palin heuren autous katheudontas, ēsan gar autōn hoi ophthalmoi bebarēmenoi.

paragraphs.text: And he left them again, and went away, and prayed a third time, saying again the same words.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀφεὶς αὐτοὺς πάλιν ἀπελθὼν προσηύξατο ἐκ τρίτου τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον εἰπὼν πάλιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai apheis autous palin apelthōn prosēuxato ek tritou ton auton logon eipōn palin.

paragraphs.text: Then cometh he to the disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
paragraphs.original: τότε ἔρχεται πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Καθεύδετε τὸ λοιπὸν καὶ ἀναπαύεσθε· ἰδοὺ ἤγγικεν ἡ ὥρα καὶ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδοται εἰς χεῖρας ἁμαρτωλῶν.
paragraphs.translit: tote erchetai pros tous mathētas kai legei autois· Katheudete to loipon kai anapauesthe· idou ēngiken hē hōra kai ho hyios tou anthrōpou paradidotai eis cheiras hamartōlōn.

paragraphs.text: Arise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that betrayeth me.
paragraphs.original: ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν· ἰδοὺ ἤγγικεν ὁ παραδιδούς με.
paragraphs.translit: egeiresthe agōmen· idou ēngiken ho paradidous me.

paragraphs.text: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priest and elders of the people.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα ἦλθεν καὶ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ὄχλος πολὺς μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων ἀπὸ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eti autou lalountos idou Ioudas heis tōn dōdeka ēlthen kai metʼ autou ochlos polys meta machairōn kai xylōn apo tōn archiereōn kai presbyterōn tou laou.

paragraphs.text: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that is he: take him.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς σημεῖον λέγων· Ὃν ἂν φιλήσω αὐτός ἐστιν· κρατήσατε αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de paradidous auton edōken autois sēmeion legōn· Hon an philēsō autos estin· kratēsate auton.

paragraphs.text: And straightway he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, Rabbi; and kissed him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εὐθέως προσελθὼν τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἶπεν· Χαῖρε, ῥαββί· καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai eutheōs proselthōn tō Iēsou eipen· Chaire, rhabbi· kai katephilēsen auton.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, [do] that for which thou art come. Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἑταῖρε, ἐφʼ ὃ πάρει. τότε προσελθόντες ἐπέβαλον τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἐκράτησαν αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de Iēsous eipen autō· Hetaire, ephʼ ho parei. tote proselthontes epebalon tas cheiras epi ton Iēsoun kai ekratēsan auton.

paragraphs.text: And behold, one of them that were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and smote the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς τῶν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἀπέσπασεν τὴν μάχαιραν αὐτοῦ καὶ πατάξας τὸν δοῦλον τοῦ ἀρχιερέως ἀφεῖλεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτίον.
paragraphs.translit: kai idou heis tōn meta Iēsou ekteinas tēn cheira apespasen tēn machairan autou kai pataxas ton doulon tou archiereōs apheilen autou to ōtion.

paragraphs.text: Then saith Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into its place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
paragraphs.original: τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀπόστρεψον τὴν μάχαιράν σου εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς, πάντες γὰρ οἱ λαβόντες μάχαιραν ἐν μαχαίρῃ ἀπολοῦνται·
paragraphs.translit: tote legei autō ho Iēsous· Apostrepson tēn machairan sou eis ton topon autēs, pantes gar hoi labontes machairan en machairē apolountai·

paragraphs.text: Or thinkest thou that I cannot beseech my Father, and he shall even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?
paragraphs.original: ἢ δοκεῖς ὅτι οὐ δύναμαι παρακαλέσαι τὸν πατέρα μου, καὶ παραστήσει μοι ἄρτι πλείω δώδεκα λεγιῶνας ἀγγέλων;
paragraphs.translit: ē dokeis hoti ou dynamai parakalesai ton patera mou, kai parastēsei moi arti pleiō dōdeka legiōnas angelōn;

paragraphs.text: How then should the scriptures be fulfilled that thus it must be?
paragraphs.original: πῶς οὖν πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαὶ ὅτι οὕτως δεῖ γενέσθαι;
paragraphs.translit: pōs oun plērōthōsin hai graphai hoti houtōs dei genesthai;

paragraphs.text: In that hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a robber with swords and staves to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and ye took me not.
paragraphs.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοῖς ὄχλοις· Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων συλλαβεῖν με; καθʼ ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐκαθεζόμην διδάσκων καὶ οὐκ ἐκρατήσατέ με.
paragraphs.translit: en ekeinē tē hōra eipen ho Iēsous tois ochlois· Hōs epi lēstēn exēlthate meta machairōn kai xylōn syllabein me; kathʼ hēmeran en tō hierō ekathezomēn didaskōn kai ouk ekratēsate me.

paragraphs.text: But all this is come to pass, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples left him, and fled.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο δὲ ὅλον γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῶσιν αἱ γραφαὶ τῶν προφητῶν. τότε οἱ μαθηταὶ πάντες ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἔφυγον.
paragraphs.translit: touto de holon gegonen hina plērōthōsin hai graphai tōn prophētōn. tote hoi mathētai pantes aphentes auton ephygon.

paragraphs.text: And they that had taken Jesus led him away to [the house of] Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.
paragraphs.original: Οἱ δὲ κρατήσαντες τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπήγαγον πρὸς Καϊάφαν τὸν ἀρχιερέα, ὅπου οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι συνήχθησαν.
paragraphs.translit: Hoi de kratēsantes ton Iēsoun apēgagon pros Kaiaphan ton archierea, hopou hoi grammateis kai hoi presbyteroi synēchthēsan.

paragraphs.text: But Peter followed him afar off, unto the court of the high priest, and entered in, and sat with the officers, to see the end.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἕως τῆς αὐλῆς τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, καὶ εἰσελθὼν ἔσω ἐκάθητο μετὰ τῶν ὑπηρετῶν ἰδεῖν τὸ τέλος.
paragraphs.translit: ho de Petros ēkolouthei autō apo makrothen heōs tēs aulēs tou archiereōs, kai eiselthōn esō ekathēto meta tōn hypēretōn idein to telos.

paragraphs.text: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought false witness against Jesus, that they might put him to death;
paragraphs.original: οἱ δὲ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τὸ συνέδριον ὅλον ἐζήτουν ψευδομαρτυρίαν κατὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὅπως αὐτὸν θανατώσωσιν,
paragraphs.translit: hoi de archiereis kai to synedrion holon ezētoun pseudomartyrian kata tou Iēsou hopōs auton thanatōsōsin,

paragraphs.text: and they found it not, though many false witnesses came. But afterward came two,
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὐχ εὗρον πολλῶν προσελθόντων ψευδομαρτύρων. ὕστερον δὲ προσελθόντες δύο
paragraphs.translit: kai ouch heuron pollōn proselthontōn pseudomartyrōn. hysteron de proselthontes dyo

paragraphs.text: and said, This man said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
paragraphs.original: εἶπαν· Οὗτος ἔφη· Δύναμαι καταλῦσαι τὸν ναὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ διὰ τριῶν ἡμερῶν οἰκοδομῆσαι.
paragraphs.translit: eipan· Houtos ephē· Dynamai katalysai ton naon tou theou kai dia triōn hēmerōn oikodomēsai.

paragraphs.text: And the high priest stood up, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἀναστὰς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Οὐδὲν ἀποκρίνῃ; τί οὗτοί σου καταμαρτυροῦσιν;
paragraphs.translit: kai anastas ho archiereus eipen autō· Ouden apokrinē; ti houtoi sou katamartyrousin;

paragraphs.text: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou art the Christ, the Son of God.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐσιώπα. καὶ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἐξορκίζω σε κατὰ τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος ἵνα ἡμῖν εἴπῃς εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ χριστὸς ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ho de Iēsous esiōpa. kai ho archiereus eipen autō· Exorkizō se kata tou theou tou zōntos hina hēmin eipēs ei sy ei ho christos ho hyios tou theou.

paragraphs.text: Jesus said unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Henceforth ye shall see the Son of man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Σὺ εἶπας· πλὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀπʼ ἄρτι ὄψεσθε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καθήμενον ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ ἐρχόμενον ἐπὶ τῶν νεφελῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: legei autō ho Iēsous· Sy eipas· plēn legō hymin, apʼ arti opsesthe ton hyion tou anthrōpou kathēmenon ek dexiōn tēs dynameōs kai erchomenon epi tōn nephelōn tou ouranou.

paragraphs.text: Then the high priest rent his garments, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy: what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard the blasphemy:
paragraphs.original: τότε ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ λέγων· Ἐβλασφήμησεν· τί ἔτι χρείαν ἔχομεν μαρτύρων; ἴδε νῦν ἠκούσατε τὴν βλασφημίαν·
paragraphs.translit: tote ho archiereus dierrēxen ta himatia autou legōn· Eblasphēmēsen· ti eti chreian echomen martyrōn; ide nyn ēkousate tēn blasphēmian·

paragraphs.text: what think ye? They answered and said, He is worthy of death.
paragraphs.original: τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ; οἱ δὲ ἀποκριθέντες εἶπαν· Ἔνοχος θανάτου ἐστίν.
paragraphs.translit: ti hymin dokei; hoi de apokrithentes eipan· Enochos thanatou estin.

paragraphs.text: Then did they spit in his face and buffet him: and some smote him with the palms of their hands,
paragraphs.original: τότε ἐνέπτυσαν εἰς τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκολάφισαν αὐτόν, οἱ δὲ ἐράπισαν
paragraphs.translit: tote eneptysan eis to prosōpon autou kai ekolaphisan auton, hoi de erapisan

paragraphs.text: saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ: who is he that struck thee?
paragraphs.original: λέγοντες· Προφήτευσον ἡμῖν, χριστέ, τίς ἐστιν ὁ παίσας σε;
paragraphs.translit: legontes· Prophēteuson hēmin, christe, tis estin ho paisas se;

paragraphs.text: Now Peter was sitting without in the court: and a maid came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus the Galilaean.
paragraphs.original: Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἐκάθητο ἔξω ἐν τῇ αὐλῇ· καὶ προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ μία παιδίσκη λέγουσα· Καὶ σὺ ἦσθα μετὰ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Γαλιλαίου·
paragraphs.translit: Ho de Petros ekathēto exō en tē aulē· kai prosēlthen autō mia paidiskē legousa· Kai sy ēstha meta Iēsou tou Galilaiou·

paragraphs.text: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο ἔμπροσθεν πάντων λέγων· Οὐκ οἶδα τί λέγεις.
paragraphs.translit: ho de ērnēsato emprosthen pantōn legōn· Ouk oida ti legeis.

paragraphs.text: And when he was gone out into the porch, another [maid] saw him, and saith unto them that were there, This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.
paragraphs.original: ἐξελθόντα δὲ εἰς τὸν πυλῶνα εἶδεν αὐτὸν ἄλλη καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἐκεῖ· Οὗτος ἦν μετὰ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου·
paragraphs.translit: exelthonta de eis ton pylōna eiden auton allē kai legei tois ekei· Houtos ēn meta Iēsou tou Nazōraiou·

paragraphs.text: And again he denied with an oath, I know not the man.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάλιν ἠρνήσατο μετὰ ὅρκου ὅτι Οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον.
paragraphs.translit: kai palin ērnēsato meta horkou hoti Ouk oida ton anthrōpon.

paragraphs.text: And after a little while they that stood by came and said to Peter, Of a truth thou also art [one] of them; for thy speech maketh thee known.
paragraphs.original: μετὰ μικρὸν δὲ προσελθόντες οἱ ἑστῶτες εἶπον τῷ Πέτρῳ· Ἀληθῶς καὶ σὺ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ, καὶ γὰρ ἡ λαλιά σου δῆλόν σε ποιεῖ·
paragraphs.translit: meta mikron de proselthontes hoi hestōtes eipon tō Petrō· Alēthōs kai sy ex autōn ei, kai gar hē lalia sou dēlon se poiei·

paragraphs.text: Then began he to curse and to swear, I know not the man. And straightway the cock crew.
paragraphs.original: τότε ἤρξατο καταθεματίζειν καὶ ὀμνύειν ὅτι Οὐκ οἶδα τὸν ἄνθρωπον. καὶ εὐθέως ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν·
paragraphs.translit: tote ērxato katathematizein kai omnyein hoti Ouk oida ton anthrōpon. kai eutheōs alektōr ephōnēsen·

paragraphs.text: And Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τοῦ ῥήματος Ἰησοῦ εἰρηκότος ὅτι Πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι τρὶς ἀπαρνήσῃ με, καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἔξω ἔκλαυσεν πικρῶς.
paragraphs.translit: kai emnēsthē ho Petros tou rhēmatos Iēsou eirēkotos hoti Prin alektora phōnēsai tris aparnēsē me, kai exelthōn exō eklausen pikrōs.
